summary: Join our course on managing refugees and displaced populations. Learn effective strategies and best practices to support vulnerable communities worldwide.
lede: Managing refugee and internally displaced populations helps humanitarian teams assess displacement-related needs and coordinate protection and essential assistance. For humanitarian professionals coordinating responses or turning field evidence into decisions, the course builds practical skills in population profiling, protection-risk and referral analysis, and service-gap assessment using established humanitarian frameworks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for humanitarian professionals who coordinate displacement responses, manage protection concerns, or convert field evidence into assistance and reporting decisions. It suits foundation-to-intermediate learners who have operational exposure but need a more consistent framework for planning and coordination.
prerequisites: No formal qualification is required. You should have basic experience in humanitarian, development, public-sector, community, protection, migration, or emergency-response work. Familiarity with field reporting, spreadsheets, or service coordination will help, but you do not need legal training, programming experience, or prior knowledge of UNHCR, OCHA, or Sphere systems. Coding is not required for completion. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted targeting and automated reporting receive conceptual and operational treatment, while KoboToolbox exercises use prepared templates and datasets.
